headlines.title_en: Henan: Industrial value-added output above designated size up 7.5% YoY in Jan-Jul
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 19: Henan Provincial Bureau of Statistics and NBS Henan Survey Team released January-July 2026 economic data for Henan Province. Jan-Jul, industrial value-added above designated size rose 7.5% YoY. By sector, mining value-added grew 3.9%, manufacturing 9.3%, and electricity, heat, gas and water production and supply fell 1.6% YoY. By product, lithium-ion batteries, NEVs, service robots, and electronic components output rose 101.3%, 32.9%, 13.6%, and 11.8% respectively. High-tech manufacturing and strategic emerging industries value-added grew 26.1% and 12.6%, contributing 38.3% and 40.7% to provincial industrial growth. headlines.title: 王毅将访问韩国、印尼
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人宣布：应韩国外长赵显、印尼外长苏吉约诺邀请，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅将于8月19日至22日访问韩国、印尼。访问印尼期间，王毅将主持中国印尼全面战略对话机制首次会议，与国防部长董军共同出席中印尼外长防长“2＋2”对话机制第二次部长级会议。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi to visit South Korea and Indonesia
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson announced: At the invitation of ROK Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiono, Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi will visit South Korea and Indonesia from Aug 19-22. During the Indonesia visit, Wang Yi will chair the first meeting of the China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue mechanism and co-chair the second ministerial meeting of the China-Indonesia Foreign and Defense "2+2" dialogue with Defense Minister Dong Jun.

headlines.title: 河南省超硬材料产业链产融对接活动在许昌市举办
headlines.summary: 近日，河南省超硬材料产业链产融对接活动在黄河旋风股份有限公司举办。座谈交流环节，黄河旋风股份有限公司、河南风优创材料技术有限公司、卓工新材料有限公司、凯利达金刚石工具有限公司、鸿泰钻石科技有限公司等企业分别介绍其核心产品、经营现状及融资需求。中原银行、中国银行、工商银行、交通银行、中鼎开源基金等机构现场推介科创贷、制造业专项贷等惠企政策，并围绕企业项目前景一对一答疑洽谈，多家银行现场表达了进一步合作意向。(人民财讯)

headlines.title_en: Henan's superhard materials industry chain capital-financing matchmaking event held in Xuchang
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Henan Province superhard materials industry chain industry-finance matchmaking event was held at Yellow River Cyclone Co., Ltd. In the discussion session, companies including Yellow River Cyclone, Henan Fengyouchuang Materials Technology, Zhuogong New Materials, Kailida Diamond Tools, and Hongtai Diamond Technology presented core products, operations, and financing needs. Institutions including Zhongyuan Bank, Bank of China, ICBC, Bank of Communications, and Zhongding Kaiyuan Fund promoted policies such as tech loans and manufacturing special loans, and held one-on-one consultations on project prospects, with multiple banks expressing further cooperation intentions. (People's Financial News)

headlines.title: 上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划：支持符合标准的优质科技企业登陆科创板上市融资，鼓励科技企业发行创新创业公司债
headlines.summary: 上海市科学技术委员会印发《上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划》。其中提出，完善科技投融资体系，强化专业化天使投资服务平台功能，优化早期投资生态。健全创业投资退出渠道，大力布局私募股权二级市场基金（S基金）、并购基金。支持打造股权投资集聚区。支持符合标准的优质科技企业登陆科创板上市融资。鼓励企业利用并购贷款试点政策实施产业链并购，用好科技创新和技术改造再贷款等结构性货币政策。鼓励科技企业发行创新创业公司债，投资机构发行科技创新债。推动金融科技产业融合示范区域建设。鼓励民资、外资等各类社会资本参与园区建设与产业创新。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Industrial Development Zone 15th Five-Year Plan: support qualified high-quality tech firms to list on STAR Market for financing, encourage tech firms to issue innovation and entrepreneurship corporate bonds
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Science and Technology Commission issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Shanghai Zhangjiang High-tech Industrial Development Zone." It proposes improving the tech investment and financing system, strengthening professional angel investment service platform functions, and optimizing the early-stage investment ecosystem. Improve venture capital exit channels, aggressively deploy private equity secondary market funds (S funds) and buyout funds. Support building equity investment clusters. Support quality tech companies meeting standards to list on STAR Market for financing. Encourage companies to use M&A loan pilot policies for supply chain M&A, and utilize structural monetary policies such as technology innovation and technical transformation relending. Encourage tech companies to issue innovative corporate bonds and investment institutions to issue technology innovation bonds. Promote fintech industry integration demonstration zones. Encourage private and foreign capital to participate in park construction and industrial innovation.

headlines.title: 上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划：加快大飞机关键材料与核心零部件检验检测等平台建设
headlines.summary: 上海市科学技术委员会印发《上海张江高新技术产业开发区发展“十五五”规划》，其中提出，聚焦民用航空发动机、机载系统、复合材料、航空制造装备、新型低空航空器等细分领域，发挥龙头企业牵引作用，以整机带动技术攻关和本土产业链培育，推动实施航空发动机研制工程等重点项目，加快大飞机关键材料与核心零部件检验检测等平台建设，提升适航审定等配套服务保障能力。支持临港园聚焦大飞机产业链，紫竹高新区聚焦航电系统开发，金山园聚焦工业级无人机等产业细分领域，加速商业化应用示范和规模化发展。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Industrial Development Zone's 15th Five-Year Plan: Accelerate construction of platforms for inspection and testing of key materials and core components for large aircraft
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Municipal Science and Technology Commission issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Shanghai Zhangjiang High-Tech Industrial Development Zone,' proposing to focus on sub-sectors such as civil aviation engines, airborne systems, composite materials, aviation manufacturing equipment, and new low-altitude aircraft; leverage leading enterprises to drive technological breakthroughs and local supply chain cultivation; promote key projects like the aviation engine development program; accelerate the construction of testing and inspection platforms for key materials and core components of large aircraft; and enhance support services such as airworthiness certification. It also supports Lin-gang Park focusing on the large aircraft industrial chain, Zizhu High-Tech Park on avionics system development, and Jinshan Park on industrial-grade drones for accelerated commercial application and scale development.
